gloss: the 11th of the month; eleven days

definitions.gloss: the eleventh day of the month
definitions.explanation: The calendar date. From the eleventh onward the dates are read regularly with にち, unlike the irregular readings for the first ten days.
A span of eleven days. Which sense is meant is clear from context, and 〜{間|かん} can be added to force the duration reading.

examples.japanese: {十一日|じゅういちにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}おう→会う：00482_au⟧。
⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧{十一日|じゅういちにち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧だ。
⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十一日|じゅういちにち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}して→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please submit the documents by the eleventh of next month.

examples.japanese: {十一日|じゅういちにち}⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十一日間|じゅういちにちかん}だった。
examples.english: The hospital stay was eleven days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧、{十一日|じゅういちにち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧。
examples.english: The construction finished in eleven days, earlier than planned.

notes:
The date readings are irregular through ⟦{十日|とおか}→十日：02917_tooka⟧ (the tenth), then become regular: {十一日|じゅういちにち}, {十二日|じゅうににち}, {十三日|じゅうさんにち}. Only ⟦{十四日|じゅうよっか}→十四日：30216_juuyokka⟧, ⟦{二十日|はつか}→二十日：02934_hatsuka⟧, and ⟦{二十四日|にじゅうよっか}→二十四日：30217_nijuuyokka⟧ break the pattern again.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {十一日|じゅういちにち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: on the eleventh
- {十一日間|じゅういちにちかん}: for eleven days
- {十一日|じゅういちにち}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: by the eleventh

TELLING THE SENSES APART:
A month name before it forces the date reading (⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧{十一日|じゅういちにち}); 〜⟦{間|かん}→〜間：28469_kan⟧ or a verb of duration forces the span reading.
